{{velocity output="false"}} ### Choose the page elements to display, globally and at space level. #set ($docExtraFields = ['showdocumenttabs']) ### The tabs contributed to the org.xwiki.plaftorm.template.docextra extension point have no preference of their own: ### their visibility is stored as '+' / '-' entries of the documentTabsVisibility property, so a ### tab left out of the list inherits the value set on the wiki or on a parent space. Their fields are therefore ### built here instead of being named in the list passed to XWiki.AdminFieldsDisplaySheet. #set ($customTabs = $services.uix.getExtensions('org.xwiki.plaftorm.template.docextra', {'sortByParameter': 'order'})) #define ($bulkActions)
## $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('admin.presentation.documenttabs.hiddenNotice'))
#end #set ($discard = $docExtraFields.add({'html': "$bulkActions"})) #if (!$customTabs.isEmpty()) #set ($objectNumber = 0) #set ($tabsVisibility = []) #set ($preferences = $doc.getObject('XWiki.XWikiPreferences')) #if ($preferences) #set ($objectNumber = $preferences.number) #set ($storedVisibility = $preferences.getValue('documentTabsVisibility')) #if ($storedVisibility) #set ($tabsVisibility = $storedVisibility) #end #end #set ($visibilityFieldName = "XWiki.XWikiPreferences_${objectNumber}_documentTabsVisibility") #end #set ($discard = $docExtraFields.addAll(['showannotations', 'showcomments', 'showattachments', 'showhistory', 'showinformation'])) #foreach ($customTab in $customTabs) #set ($tabParameters = $customTab.parameters) #set ($tabLabel = "$!tabParameters.title") #if ($tabLabel == '') #set ($tabLabel = "$!tabParameters.name") #end #if ($tabLabel == '') #set ($tabLabel = $customTab.id) #end #set ($fieldId = "documentTabVisibility_${foreach.index}") #set ($shownEntry = "+${customTab.id}") #set ($hiddenEntry = "-${customTab.id}") #define ($customTabField)
## $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('admin.presentation.documenttabs.hint', [$customTab.id]))
#end #set ($discard = $docExtraFields.add({'html': "$customTabField"})) #end #set ($params = { 'docextra': $docExtraFields, 'header': ['title', 'meta'] }) #if ("$!editor" == 'globaladmin') #set ($params.footer = ['webcopyright', 'version']) #end $xwiki.jsx.use('XWiki.AdminPresentationSheet')## {{/velocity}} {{include reference="XWiki.AdminFieldsDisplaySheet" /}}
